name: Schwerinsdorf (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and yellow with a broad red middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Schwerinsdorf (a red lozenge on yellow and a star and clover leaf on red).
history: Municipal flag of Schwerinsdorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Schwerinsdorf arms — lozenge, star and clover leaf
